'''Brian Choongphol''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Phoenix tournament (10 June)]] on 10 June 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Brentson's Beats (Mind What You Have Learned start)]], according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d882">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-phoenix-az-6-10-00d882/ phoenix-az-6-10-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-phoenix-az-6-10-00d882/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
